identity.note: Source car is a UK 5-door hatch, plate RF67 FPX, GTE badge on grille, dark grey/blue metallic, gloss-black alloys. Generation read from the facelift front (full-width lower grille bar, LED signature) in the owner-supplied cinch studio orbit. Trim/engine NOT asserted beyond the visible badge (accuracy rule). NOT interchangeable with vw_golf_mk8.json -- that is a different car and fitting this body to it would stretch it, the mistake already paid for on the Yaris.

length_m.source: published VW Golf Mk7/7.5 5-door hatch dimensions

width_m.source: published VW Golf Mk7/7.5 hatch dimensions (excl. mirrors)

height_m.source: published VW Golf Mk7/7.5 hatch dimensions

wheelbase_m.source: published VW Golf Mk7/7.5 hatch dimensions

glass_thickness_m.source: typical laminated automotive glazing 3-5mm; pinned so a length-scaled default never drifts this car

unverified.track_front_m: not asserted -- Mk7.5 track varies by wheel/tyre package and no figure was confirmed for this car
unverified.front_overhang_m: not asserted -- no published split confirmed for this generation
unverified.gte_specific_dims: GTE ride height and kerb figures differ from the base hatch and were NOT confirmed; the figures above are the base 5-door hatch published set

tyre.source: published VW option fitment for the Mk7.5 Golf GTE (17in 'Madrid'); the standard 205/55R16 has an outer diameter within 0.3% of it, so the wheel's OUTER geometry is insensitive to which fitment the real car wears. 17in chosen because the reference orbit shows thin-sidewall large gloss-black alloys; the rim size is a judgement from the photos, not a decoded fact.

references.note: Owner-supplied cinch studio orbit of ONE car -- plate RF67 FPX legible in all eight. orbit_* are common-scale (equalised body height) on one flat grey; fill_* are per-view max-fill RGBA for single-image generation.
